input_units: raw int16 counts as read from MPU6050 (no scaling to g or deg/s)
window_layout: 6 axes, 128 consecutive samples each, non-overlapping windows

formulas.kurt: excess kurtosis: mean((x-mu)^4)/var^2 - 3 with population moments; 0 if var==0
formulas.domfreq: (argmax over k=1..64 of |rfft(x-mean(x))[k]|) * FS / N (bin 0 excluded; first max wins ties)

sensor_configuration.note: defaults set by electroniccats MPU6050 initialize(); all thresholds are in raw counts under these settings and are invalid under other ranges

sampling_requirement.note: exactly 100 Hz, uniformly spaced (timer-driven); domfreq thresholds assume bin spacing FS/N = 0.78125 Hz. The current Phase 1 firmware uses delay(10) plus read/print time, so its actual rate is below 100 Hz and must be changed in Phase 4

offset_test_scope: The offset test shows the 18 mean-removed features are invariant to constant per-axis offsets BY CONSTRUCTION. It does NOT test axis rotation / mounting orientation changes, sensitivity/gain (scale) errors, or temperature drift; these are open questions for Phase 6 hardware validation.
rms_excluded: raw rms includes the DC term (gravity, mounting orientation, sensor offset/calibration), which differs on real hardware; the 24-feature model's top split was on az_rms (DC dominated). rms is intentionally not an input.
comparison_rule: go left if x[feature] <= threshold else right; thresholds are float32 (rounded down so float32 x <= threshold matches sklearn exactly); inputs cast to float32
vote_rule: n/a (single tree: output the leaf class)
